explanation: Searched Mathlib’s profinite-group limits and open-normal-subgroup results, along with subgroup map/iInf and compactness finite-intersection lemmas. Mathlib identifies a profinite group with the limit of its finite quotients, but I found no distinct declaration asserting that every compatible family of quotient subgroups is exactly the family of images of its reconstructed subgroup; obtaining this result requires the compactness and common-refinement argument in the proof.
